$comment: AUTHORITATIVE operation class for every PM2 app in ecosystem.config.js.
Used by scripts/ops/pm2-guard.ts to decide what a given operation is allowed
to touch. Classification is DECLARED here, never inferred from name prefixes:
'ops-*' and 'hermes-*' are conventions, and a convention that controls a
production mutation is one rename away from being wrong.
1. exact coverage — every ecosystem app appears here, and nothing extra.
Adding an app to ecosystem.config.js without classifying it FAILS CI,
and the guard refuses to operate on an unclassified app.
2. structural consistency — a declared 'app-service' must NOT have
cron_restart, and every '*-cron' class MUST have it. That catches a
mislabelled entry, e.g. db-maintainer declared as app-service.
